ideas.pitch: An ambient audio-first operating layer for smart home automation that replaces visual dashboards with contextual conversational triggers.
ideas.title: AuraVoice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the 'No Screens' challenge track, appealing to judges looking for novel HCI solutions that eliminate visual screen fatigue.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent autonomous framework where specialized LLM agents debate, critique, and execute complex code refactoring tasks collaboratively.
ideas.title: NexusSwarm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent orchestration and inter-agent communication protocols, aligning with the 'Chain of Command' challenge.

ideas.pitch: A real-time behavioral firewall and automatic kill switch that detects rogue agent loops and unauthorized API calls before execution.
ideas.title: CircuitBreaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical AI safety and governance requirements, tapping into the rising demand for reliable fail-safes in autonomous systems ('The Kill Switch' track).

ideas.pitch: A spatial haptic feedback controller interface for hands-free industrial automation monitoring via wearable audio and tactile responses.
ideas.title: HapticField
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware-adjacent peripheral interactions with screenless computing, giving judges a tangible, physical prototype to experience.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized voting and conflict-resolution protocol for hierarchical AI agent swarms to achieve zero-hallucination task planning.
ideas.title: SyntacticConsensus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous mathematical consensus checks among autonomous agents, winning over technical judges looking for robust engineering over simple prompt wrappers.
